quiz.q: In which year did William Cecil become Lord Treasurer?
quiz.why: Cecil started as Principal Secretary and became Lord Treasurer in 1572, which put him in charge of the nation's money.

quiz.q: How did William Cecil usually help Elizabeth make decisions?
options: He wrote memos weighing up the pros and cons
He argued hard for one plan in council
He asked Parliament to make the choice
He let Walsingham decide for the queen
quiz.why: Cecil drafted detailed memos setting out the pros and cons of every option, then waited for Elizabeth to decide.

quiz.q: Which Mary was at the centre of the Catholic plots and was executed in 1587?
options: Mary, Queen of Scots, Elizabeth's cousin
Mary Tudor, the former queen of England
quiz.why: The plots involved Mary, Queen of Scots, Elizabeth's Catholic cousin, while Mary I had died back in 1558.

quiz.q: How was Walsingham's spy network mainly paid for?
options: By money taken from Catholic priests
quiz.why: Walsingham ran the network through his own household and paid for most of it himself, so he died in debt in 1590.

quiz.q: Which phrase from historian Penry Williams sums up the Privy Council?
options: The Council ruled, the Queen agreed
The Council advised, the Queen decided
The Queen spoke, the Council obeyed
quiz.why: The councillors debated and gave advice, but Elizabeth kept the final say for herself.
